evidence: internal/backup.go:476-477 -- workingDIR := os.Getenv(envGitWorkingDir); if workingDIR == "" { workingDIR = filepath.Join(backupDIR, workingDIRName) }
internal/backup.go:140-145 -- func resolveWorkingDir(backupDir string) string { if w := os.Getenv(envGitWorkingDir); w != "" { return w }; return filepath.Join(backupDir, workingDIRName) }
findings.suggested_fix: In createWorkingDir, replace the getenv/if/filepath.Join block with `workingDIR := resolveWorkingDir(backupDIR)` (behavior is identical).
findings.title: createWorkingDir re-implements existing resolveWorkingDir
